name: EventsIntroBand - Closing Flush Against The Calendar
description: The same title and standfirst wrapped in the band /events actually renders. Captured apart from EventsIntro because the only thing separating them is spacing, which a picture shows and prose does not: this band closes with NO bottom padding, so the Luma calendar following it on the route reads as one block with it rather than a second one. Without that rule the standfirst would end, 78px of nothing would follow, and the calendar's own 78px would follow that - the standfirst introduces the calendar directly, so the two belong together. The band exists at all so pages/events.astro stays imports and composition with no raw markup of its own.
